_note: Poison: maker (rebuild-heroes.md, section 8k, path 2; phase 8 part 6, 8f-3). Self-sufficient (build-tuning.md). The viper takes Grit's place (a patch's companions), and Bond follows it; Nest's nestlings are a companion kit that doesn't start (10% of her max HP and 20% of her ATK).
